children: shares perked up 4% during early post-market trading on Thursday after revealing a new partnership with OpenAI

Intapp provides software for highly regulated industries such as law, accounting, and investment banking. Celeste, Intapp's expert AI coworker, is now a plug-in for ChatGPT Enterprise. The plug-in brings a legal firm's proprietary context and methods into ChatGPT Enterprise.

"The law is the same for every firm," said Thad Jampol, co-founder and chief product officer at Intapp. "What a firm knows about its clients, its methods, its matters, and the judgment built from handling them for decades—that's the firm's real franchise. We've spent more than two decades encoding it into the systems firms already run on. Being available in ChatGPT Enterprise means that firms now run inside the models lawyers are already using."
The Celeste plug-in for ChatGPT Enterprise is available to eligible Intapp Celeste clients starting today.

"We believe the next generation of AI for law will be built around what makes each firm distinctive—its expertise, judgment, and way of working," said Jason Boehmig, OpenAI's general manager of the legal industry. "By building alongside Intapp, we’re turning that expertise into AI lawyers can use every day, creating new ways for firms to serve their clients and shape the future of legal work."

title: Intapp perks up after partnering with OpenAI to integrate legal expertise into GPT Enterprise
